name: KField
summary: A field in the one field family: dim label above, one filled surface (no outline, 12px radius, textareas auto-grow), hint and error below, tied to the control.

error.description: The refusal, next to the control.

children.description: Renders the control with the ids it is given.

notes: 16px text and 44px height on a phone.
The label stays visible while typing; never a placeholder instead of a label.
No outline at rest: the visible label names the field; focus draws the 2px ink ring (3:1 or better); a transparent border keeps the edge in forced colours.

dont: Never show a form error as a banner.
